messages.subject: A practical value proposition for Statkraft Markets | Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Granheim,

I am writing because the intersection of market regulation, institutional engagement and energy transition within Statkraft Markets closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with a country-facing mandate spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive coordination. My work includes stakeholder alignment around large-scale solar and battery investments, regulatory matters, cross-functional delivery and evidence-based sustainability governance.

Rather than send a conventional application, I prepared the attached executive value brief around specific areas where my experience may support Statkraft Markets: regulatory stakeholder alignment, external positioning, cross-functional execution, industrial energy-transition interfaces and international market development. The final three pages contain my executive CV.

I would welcome a short conversation about whether this profile aligns with the current Market Regulatory Affairs requirement or a broader international mandate within Markets. I am based in Guyana, open to relocation, and would require employer-supported Norwegian work authorization.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
+592 608 4735

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal for Statkraft Markets
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Statkraft's Markets business sits where renewable generation, industrial competitiveness, power-market design, regulatory policy and customer solutions converge. My proposition is to add an operator-grounded international perspective at this intersection. I lead government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and executive coordination for a major mining operation within Zijin Mining Group, including work around industrial solar, battery storage, public institutions and cross-functional delivery. This experience is relevant to mandates requiring disciplined stakeholder alignment, regulatory interpretation, executive decision support and translation of external expectations into measurable internal action across complex regulated markets.
strategic_brief.company_context: Statkraft renewed its strategy around competitive renewable development, value-maximising asset ownership and operation, and industry-leading market solutions. The Markets business is responsible for trading, origination, energy management, international markets and business development. Current activity also shows Statkraft using long-term industrial power agreements and battery optimisation to connect renewable generation with industrial demand, system flexibility and predictable commercial outcomes. The live Senior Advisor, Market Regulatory Affairs position in Oslo reinforces the importance of regulatory intelligence and stakeholder engagement. This creates a setting where strong institutional relationships, structured regulatory execution and cross-functional coordination directly support commercial performance and market growth.

opportunities.title: Regulatory stakeholder intelligence and execution
opportunities.rationale: Power-market regulation increasingly shapes commercial structures, industrial competitiveness, renewable investment and market access. The strongest regulatory teams do more than monitor policy. They connect emerging rules with commercial exposure, internal owners, stakeholder positions and disciplined follow-through across markets.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I bring hands-on experience translating regulator and government expectations into executive briefs, action owners, evidence requirements and cross-functional delivery. I would apply the same discipline to market-regulatory priorities, especially where international business development and non-Nordic institutional contexts require structured engagement.

opportunities.title: Industrial energy-transition stakeholder alignment
opportunities.rationale: Statkraft's long-term industrial power agreements show the strategic link between energy supply, competitiveness, jobs and decarbonisation. Customers increasingly need commercial solutions supported by credible regulatory, sustainability and stakeholder narratives across public and private institutions.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: My current role connects a capital-intensive industrial operator with energy, environmental, mining and other public institutions. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, giving me practical exposure to industrial decarbonisation interfaces.

opportunities.title: International market and institutional bridge
opportunities.rationale: Statkraft operates across diverse regulatory and institutional environments. International growth benefits from leaders who understand how corporate priorities are interpreted by governments, regulators, communities and strategic partners, especially in markets where institutional context materially affects execution speed and reputation.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I operate daily between multinational corporate priorities and national institutions in a developing-market setting. I would bring a practical country-facing lens to market entry, stakeholder mapping, partnership development, institutional risk and executive communication for international mandates.

opportunities.title: Evidence-led governance and executive decision support
opportunities.rationale: Regulated energy markets require defensible decisions, clear ownership and traceable evidence. Regulatory positioning becomes stronger when stakeholder commitments, operating data and management actions are connected through repeatable governance rather than handled as separate communications exercises.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I have coordinated regulatory submissions, inspections, corrective actions and a carbon-data assurance pilot built around source ownership and traceability. I would bring that governance discipline to regulatory projects, market positions and senior decision support across Markets.

days_0_30: Map priority regulatory, institutional and market-stakeholder interfaces for the assigned portfolio.
Review current positions, decision pathways, regulatory dependencies and external commitments.
Identify high-value areas where non-Nordic or industrial stakeholder experience adds immediate perspective.
days_31_60: Build an executive regulatory and stakeholder dashboard linking issues to commercial exposure, owners and deadlines.
Strengthen engagement plans for priority authorities, industry bodies, customers and strategic partners.
Create concise decision briefs connecting regulatory developments with market and business implications.
days_61_90: Support priority market-regulatory workstreams and institutional engagement with documented follow-through.
Embed consistent escalation, evidence and accountability routines across relevant functions.
Develop a repeatable approach for stakeholder intelligence in selected international or industrial market contexts.
days_91_180: Scale the strongest governance and stakeholder practices across additional priority markets or commercial workstreams.
Measure improvements in decision speed, issue closure, stakeholder readiness and regulatory risk visibility.
Support broader international growth initiatives where regulatory context and institutional relationships affect execution.

potential_impact: Stronger conversion of regulatory developments into timely commercial and executive decisions.
Clearer stakeholder ownership, evidence trails and escalation across complex market-regulatory workstreams.
Additional international perspective for industrial customer, government and regulator engagement in growth markets.
Better integration of sustainability, market regulation and institutional positioning around energy-transition opportunities.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, regulatory coordination and stakeholder strategy within a multinational mining group.
Practical energy-transition exposure through stakeholder alignment around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.
Senior engagement across ministries, regulators and public institutions spanning mining, environment, energy, aviation, labour, standards, taxation and investment.
Track record converting external requirements into executive briefs, accountable owners, evidence, deadlines and cross-functional delivery.
